statements.status_notes: Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.Mono.browser-wasm 8.0.8 is the .NET runtime embedded inside the @kiota-community/kiota-wasm@0.0.3 WebAssembly bundle. The runtime version cannot be upgraded independently; a fix requires upstream kiota-wasm to publish a new release embedding a patched .NET runtime. Investigation is ongoing.
